messagesLocale.description: Locale of this file. Language names in the popup are shown in it.

extDescription.message: Translates pages with a hotkey and restores the original exactly, and makes Chrome's built-in translator pick the real page language.

badgeTitleChanged.message: NuTranslate: page language set to $1 (the page declared $2)

popupUnavailableText.message: Extensions can't run on browser pages and the Chrome Web Store. If this is a regular site that was already open when NuTranslate was installed, reload it.

popupDisabledSite.message: NuTranslate is turned off for this site.

statusUncertain.message: left as is, the language is unclear

statusNoText.message: left as is, no text at load time

statusError.message: stopped on an error, see Details

modelFixed.message: got a hint, its sample had another language at the $1

modelPartial.message: got a hint, part of its sample is still another language

modelNotEnoughText.message: too little text for a hint

optionsIntro.message: These settings help Chrome's built-in translator, for when you use it. NuTranslate corrects the language that Chrome starts translating from.

optEnabledHelp.message: When a page declares one language in <html lang> but its text is in another one, NuTranslate replaces the declaration before Chrome reads it.

optSteeringHelp.message: Chrome guesses the language from only 768 characters: the start, the middle and the end of the page text. When that sample hits an English cookie banner or footer, Chrome gives up. NuTranslate then adds hidden text in the page's real language for the single frame in which Chrome looks, and removes it right after.

optDebug.message: Log decisions to the page console

optDebugHelp.message: Useful when reporting a site where detection goes wrong.

optDisabledHostsHelp.message: One domain per line. Subdomains are included.

commandToggle.message: Translate the page or show the original

toastRestoredForSubmit.message: the original is back so that the form is sent as the site expects

toastChromeTranslated.message: Chrome's built-in translator has already translated this page. Show the original from the translate icon in the address bar.

errNoKey.message: add your Google Cloud API key in the NuTranslate settings, or switch to Chrome's offline translator there

errOnDeviceUnsupported.message: this Chrome has no offline translator, it needs Chrome 138 or newer on a computer

errOnDevicePair.message: Chrome's offline translator has no $1 → $2 pair

errOnDeviceDownload.message: download the $1 → $2 language pack in the NuTranslate settings first

errOnDeviceSource.message: the offline translator needs the page language, and NuTranslate could not tell it

popupEngineNoKey.message: add a Google Cloud key or pick the offline translator in the settings

optEngineAuto.message: Automatic: Google Cloud when a key is set, otherwise Chrome's offline translator

optEngineCloud.message: Google Cloud Translation, the Google Translate engine with your own API key

optEngineOnDevice.message: Chrome's offline translator: free, nothing leaves the computer, lower quality

optCloudKeyHelp.message: Create a key in the Google Cloud console with the Cloud Translation API enabled, ideally restricted to that API. The key stays in this browser and is only sent to translation.googleapis.com. Google charges per character beyond a monthly free allowance.

optUsage.message: Sent to Google Cloud this month: $1 characters

optOnDeviceHelp.message: Chrome downloads a pack for each language pair once. Chrome only allows the download after a click, so start it here.

optOnDeviceUnsupported.message: this Chrome has no offline translator (Chrome 138 or newer on a computer is needed)

optAutoLanguages.message: Always translate pages in these languages

optAutoLanguagesHelp.message: Language codes separated by commas, for example lt, lv. The hotkey still switches translation off in a tab.

optRestoreOnSubmit.message: Show the original before a form is sent

optRestoreOnSubmitHelp.message: Right before a form is submitted, NuTranslate puts the original text back, so the site receives exactly what it expects. Press the hotkey to translate again.

optToast.message: Show short messages on the page

optShortcutHelp.message: Chrome keeps extension shortcuts on its own settings page.
